name: Dynamic Saunas Monaco 6-Person Ultra-Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna
description: Dynamic Monaco Elite 6-Person Ultra-Low EMF (Between 3-5 mg) Far Infrared Sauna - Canadian Hemlock Introducing the DYN-6996-01 Elite Ultra-Low EMF Far Infrared Sauna - the epitome of wellness and luxury. Crafted with precision, this sauna offers an unparalleled escape to a world of relaxation and rejuvenation. Experience the transformative power of ultra-low EMF far-infrared heat as it envelops your body, providing therapeutic benefits such as improved blood circulation and detoxification. The advanced technology ensures a safe and peaceful environment for a truly immersive experience. Create your own personal haven of tranquility in the comfort of your home with the DYN-6996-01 Far Infrared Sauna. Whether you seek relief from stress or want to elevate your wellness routine, this sauna is your key to unlocking a life of blissful well-being. Features 6-person capacity Ultra Low EMF - EMF Between 3 to 5 mg 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels FM/CD radio with MP3 auxiliary connection with 4 built-in speakers, 15” LCD Monitor with DVD Player Interior reading/chromotherapy lighting system Exterior accent lighting Interior and exterior LED control panel Natural hemlock wood construction (Natural Finish) Electrical service: 2 separate dedicated 20 amp 120 volt outlets, and two separate 20 amp breakers required. (consult a certified electrician to install a 20 amp outlet and 20 amp breaker) Clasp together assembly 15 Carbon PureTech Near Zero EMF Heat Emitters (Heating Panels) Tempered glass door Roof vent Specifications Exterior dimensions (WDH): 73″ x 61″ x 79″ (roof overhang: add 6") Interior dimensions (WDH): 68″ x 57″ x 72″ Sauna weight: 750 lbs. Shipping weight: 950 lbs. Ships in 5 boxes All Golden Designs Saunas Include a 5-Year Limited Warranty. View more details here. What are you waiting for? Order your infrared sauna today and experience the Golden Designs difference. Videos
